2608.11949.title: ExRole: From Team Trajectories to Executable Roles in Multi-Agent Language Models
2608.11949.paper_summary: Roles provide an interpretable interface for organizing language-model agents, yet most multi-agent systems treat them as hand-written prompt labels disconnected from learned behavior and parameter updates. We argue that a useful role should instead be an executable control variable: it should summarize behavior predictive of future utility, guide subsequent interaction, and identify the trainable capacity responsible for that behavior. We introduce ExRole, a trajectory-to-role framework that learns future-aware role prototypes from prefix-local team traces, resolves them into readable instructions and token-aligned role markers, and optionally routes shared LoRA rank slots with turn-aligned credit. Across MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA, ExRole improves over single-agent search by 15.0/14.4 and 13.5/16.1 EM/F1 points, respectively. Against the strongest non-ExRole controls, the corresponding gains remain 11.5/11.6 and 7.7/9.7 points. Across both benchmarks, the controlled results consistently favor trajectory-induced role conditioning over role-free, manual, random, and shuffled alternatives. Role-Agent-Turn interventions further show that the induced roles capture transferable behavioral specialization beyond fixed agent identities or turn positions.
2608.11949.paper_summary_zh: 角色為組織語言模型代理提供了一個可解釋的介面，然而大多數多代理系統將其視為與學習行為和參數更新無關的手寫提示標籤。我們主張，有用的角色應該是一個可執行的控制變量：它應該總結預測未來效用的行為，指導後續互動，並識別負責該行為的可訓練能力。我們介紹了ExRole，一個從前綴本地團隊軌跡學習未來感知角色原型的軌跡到角色框架，將其解析為可讀的指令和與標記對齊的角色標記，並選擇性地路由共享的LoRA排名槽與回合對齊的信用。在MuSiQue和2WikiMultiHopQA上，ExRole在單代理搜索中分別提高了15.0/14.4和13.5/16.1的EM/F1分數。與最強的非ExRole控制相比，相應的增益保持在11.5/11.6和7.7/9.7分。在這兩個基準中，受控結果始終支持基於軌跡的角色條件優於無角色的、手動的、隨機的和洗牌的替代方案。角色-代理-回合干預進一步顯示，所誘導的角色捕捉了超越固定代理身份或回合位置的可轉移行為專業化。
